'''''Campanula erinus''''' is a species of annual herb in the genus ''[[Campanula]]'' (bellflowers). They have a self-supporting growth form. Individuals can grow to 11 cm tall.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Campanula erinus L. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/5133070|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=Campanula erinus (Small Bellflower) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/CAMP/Campanula_erinus.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>
